mapper.insert: insert into report_task(task_id, user_id, file_name, file_path, status, stage, error_message, retry_count, created_at, updated_at) values (#{taskId}, #{userId}, #{fileName}, #{filePath}, #{status}, #{stage}, #{errorMessage}, #{retryCount}, now(), now())
mapper.select: select id, task_id, user_id, file_name, file_path, status, stage, error_message, retry_count, created_at, updated_at from report_task where task_id = #{taskId} and user_id = #{userId} limit 1
select id, task_id, user_id, file_name, file_path, status, stage, error_message, retry_count, created_at, updated_at from report_task where task_id = #{taskId} limit 1
mapper.update: update report_task set status = #{status}, stage = #{stage}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = now() where task_id = #{taskId}
update report_task set retry_count = #{retryCount}, updated_at = now() where task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.select: select t.task_id as taskId, t.file_name as fileName, t.status as status, t.stage as stage, t.error_message as errorMessage, ( select i.summary from report_interpretation i where i.task_id = t.task_id order by i.id desc limit 1 ) as summary, t.created_at as createdAt, t.updated_at as updatedAt from report_task t where t.user_id = #{userId} order by t.created_at desc limit #{limit}
